recent.text: On November 15, 1988, Wayne Gretzky extended his scoring streak to 18 games when he scored his 14th and 15th goals of the season against the Vancouver Canucks. recent.text: On November 15, 1969, the @LAKings signed free agent defenseman Jean Potvin from the Ottawa 67's. recent.text: Brandt Clarke on what's missing right now - "Capitalizing on chances. I had 2 Grade-A chances in the second period & no goals resulted from it. That's not good enough.....I take accountability for those situations. It's frustrating. Goals are hard to come by & it's frustrating."
recent.author: Zach Dooley

recent.text: Quinton Byfield after tonight’s loss - “It’s just frustrating right now. We need more from myself right now. Need more from other guys as well.….its not good. We just need guys to step up, including myself. I need to step up.”
